what: Vertiv makes the power and cooling equipment inside data centres: uninterruptible power supplies, switchgear, busways, air and liquid cooling systems, and the service network that maintains them.
customers: Hyperscale cloud and AI data centre operators, colocation providers, telecom networks and industrial sites.
money: power and cooling equipment and services for North and South America
the same products outside the Americas
moat: Equipment specified into data centre designs years ahead, a global service network, and liquid cooling know-how that AI racks now require.
risks: Orders are concentrated among a few very large cloud customers
A pause in AI capital spending would hit it immediately
Competitors are expanding capacity for the same demand
The shares price in continued rapid growth
opportunities: Revenue grew about 28% in the last financial year as AI data centre building accelerated
Liquid cooling for high-density AI racks is a new product category where it is early
Service revenue on installed equipment grows with the base and carries better margins
watch: Orders and backlog, which lead revenue, and the book-to-bill ratio.
